title: TeleCash runs its Mobile Financial Services platform on KubeDB with HA and DR
tagline:
TeleCash runs its mobile financial services on
KubeDB with HA and DR
description: A regulated mobile financial services provider in Bangladesh now runs its core PostgreSQL layer on Kubernetes: a highly available primary cluster at the data center and a live disaster recovery replica at a geographically separate site.
customer_description: TeleCash operates in the Mobile Financial Services (MFS) arena in Bangladesh, bringing unbanked segments of society into the formal banking channel through financial inclusion. A subsidiary of Southeast Bank PLC, it offers person-to-person and business transfers, bill and merchant payments through Bangla QR, remittance disbursement, and mobile top-up.

customer_highlights.text: PostgreSQL on Kubernetes, managed by KubeDB
HA primary cluster plus a live DR replica

value_props_description: Enterprise HA and DR for PostgreSQL, with Kubernetes-native operations and OEM-backed support.
compliance_note: Running production workloads for a Bangladesh Bank regulated MFS platform
comparison_title: From TeleCash requirements to a live deployment
comparison_description: TeleCash asked for an enterprise-grade, cloud-native PostgreSQL platform on Kubernetes, with HA inside the data center and DR at a separate site. This is what is running today.

challenge_title: A financial platform cannot afford a fragile database layer
challenge_key_pains: Site-level resilience · Automated failover · Recoverability · Regulatory alignment · Vendor-backed support
challenge_summary: A regulated mobile financial services platform needed an enterprise-grade PostgreSQL layer on Kubernetes, with HA inside the data center and DR at a separate site.

challenge_items.title: A core database for money movement
challenge_items.description: Person-to-person transfers, merchant payments, bill payments, and remittances all depend on one database layer that must stay available.

challenge_items.title: HA and DR, treated separately
challenge_items.description: Automated failover inside the primary data center, plus a geographically separate DR site that can be promoted after a site-level disaster.

challenge_items.title: Regulated, supported, recoverable
challenge_items.description: Security and recoverability aligned with Bangladesh Bank ICT guidance for MFS operators, backed by OEM production support.

solution_title: HA at the data center, a live replica at the DR site
solution_description: AppsCode Ltd. designed and deployed two KubeDB clusters on Kubernetes, one per site, each paired with PgPool connection pooling.

solution_items.title: HA primary cluster at the data center
solution_items.description: A KubeDB-managed PostgreSQL cluster of 3 instances, fronted by 2 PgPool instances. The data center side totals 208 GiB of memory and 60 cores.

solution_items.title: Live DR replica at a separate site
solution_items.description: A second KubeDB cluster at a geographically separate site, with 2 PostgreSQL and 2 PgPool instances, continuously replicating from the primary (72 GiB, 24 cores).

solution_items.title: Operator-managed lifecycle
solution_items.description: The KubeDB operator manages both clusters on Kubernetes, so database operations follow the same declarative model as the rest of the platform.

solution_items.title: OEM support and certified delivery
solution_items.description: 24x7x365 OEM production support is active for the one-year term. Smart Data Technologies Ltd., AppsCode's authorized distributor in Bangladesh, issued a work completion certificate on September 22, 2026.

timeline.title: Requirements and RFP
timeline.description: TeleCash called for an enterprise-grade, cloud-native PostgreSQL platform with HA at the data center and DR at a separate site for its MFS platform.

timeline.title: Design, deployment, and go-live
timeline.description: AppsCode Ltd. designed, implemented, and deployed the DC and DR KubeDB clusters. The project went live and a work completion certificate was issued on September 22, 2026.

timeline.title: Production support
timeline.description: 24x7x365 OEM production support is active for the one-year subscription term.

timeline.title: QA environment
timeline.description: A reduced-scale QA environment mirroring production's PostgreSQL and PgPool setup is planned.
